name: High-Neck Embroidered Blouse
description: A structured blouse that adds sophistication to silk and heavy sarees.
pairing_tips: Best with Banarasi, Kanjivaram, and heavy silk sarees.
Keep jewellery balanced because the neckline is already strong.

name: Pearl-Work Blouse
description: A refined blouse option that works beautifully with pastel and organza sarees.
pairing_tips: Use with pearl earrings or soft stone jewellery.
Works well for modern wedding looks.

name: Corset Sequin Blouse
description: A glamorous blouse for evening saree looks and partywear styling.
pairing_tips: Pair with flowy georgette or chiffon sarees.
Skip heavy neckpieces and use statement earrings.

name: Boat-Neck Cotton Blouse
description: A clean and practical blouse design for everyday, office, and minimal looks.
pairing_tips: Use with printed cottons, linen sarees, and handloom drapes.
Add a watch, studs, or oxidised jewellery.

name: Mirror-Work Blouse
description: A lively festive blouse that adds sparkle to haldi, mehendi, and celebratory saree looks.
pairing_tips: Pair with floral or bright sarees.
Keep accessories fun and not too heavy.
